attribution: Oxford-IIIT Pet Dataset: Omkar M. Parkhi, Andrea Vedaldi, Andrew Zisserman, C. V. Jawahar; Cats and Dogs, CVPR 2012. Image copyright remains with original owners.
prepared_representation: Hugging Face dataset-viewer cached JPEG bytes; may be re-encoded from the original dataset image. The hashes below pin these exact bytes.
retrieval: Resolve /rows metadata for the selected row, require x-revision and image ID plus integer/name breed annotations to match, then download the signed cached image URL and require the pinned size and SHA-256. If upstream revision or encoding changes, fail rather than silently replace the workload.
selection_rule: For each of the ten breeds in workload.json order, take the next fourteen test-split rows after excluding that manifest's first two. No predictions were inspected for these selected images. Phase p uses new within-breed ranks 2p and 2p+1 (zero-based after exclusion). For each rank, rotate the original ten-breed order left by p. Each consecutive group of twenty forms the next unchanged scenario phase. Every phase contains two previously unused images per breed.
scope: 140 unique Oxford-IIIT Pet test images, disjoint from the 20-image development comparison and Chelsea warmup. The same 140-image trace is repeated across strategies and repetitions, not treated as independent images each time. The breeds, policy, deadlines, and stage cadence were retained after the small development comparison; no threshold or label is tuned using this validation set. This is a dog-only local validation; overlap with ImageNet pretraining is unknown and general accuracy or universal deadline guarantees are not established.
ordering_review: Before predictions, inspection of selection metadata showed the same breed would lead every phase. Rotating the breed order per phase changes only order, not the selected 140 images, stage membership, labels, policy, or deadlines.
